No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result NDC Inaugurates New Headquarters, Presents CoR To Candidates by James Kwen 7 seconds ago in Politics Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram The Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) is to inaurgtate its newly acquired National Secretariat located in Jabi, Abuja on Monday.
National Publicity Secretary of the party, Osa Director disclosed this in a statement on Sunday.
According to the statement, the party will also inaugurate its National Campaign Council (NCC) and present Certificates of Return to candidates of the party on the same
It also restated that the NDC would hold its National Executive Committee (NEC) meeting in Abuja earlier Monday.
“The National Executive Committee (NEC) of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) wishes to announce its programme of activities scheduled for Monday, 26th October, 2026.
The activities are as follows: the meeting of the National Executive Committee (NEC) of the party will hold as follows: Date: Monday, 26th October, 2026. Time: 10:00 am prompt Venue: JD Vance Centre, opposite A-Class Park, Kashim Ibrahim Way, Maitama, Abuja. Please note that admission is strictly by invitation, and only members of the NEC shall be admitted.
“The commissioning of the newly acquired National Secretariat of the party located in Jabi, Abuja, will take place at *2:00 pm* on the same day.
“The inauguration of the National Campaign Council (NCC) and presentation of Certificates of Return to candidates of the party will commence at *5:00 pm*. This will be followed by a dinner.
“Attendance at the NCC inauguration is restricted to members of the National Working Committee (NWC), the Presidential Candidate and his Running Mate, Governorship Candidates, and National Assembly Candidates only.
“We appreciate the continued support and loyalty of our members across the country. Together, we can make a New Nigeria Possible,”the statement read.
